name: Assistance for Purchase of House (HBOCWWB)
benefit:
1. Under this scheme, an interest-free loan of up to ₹2,00,000/- is provided to registered construction workers for the purchase or construction of their houses.

**Note:** The Board will provide financial assistance in the shape of interest compensation upto ₹1,00,000/- through banks to the construction workers, who are beneficiaries of Pradhan Mantri Awaas Yojana for the construction of a house.
_eligibility_text:
1. The applicant should be registered under the Haryana Building &amp; Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.
   1. The registered worker should have regular membership for at least 5 years and 8 years are left to attain the age of 60 years.
   1. The maximum age of the worker should be 52 years. So that he/she can repay the loan in the next 8 years.
   1. This facility will be available once in a lifetime.
   1. The application frequency is limited to once.
